CustomField.label: Sample Data Key
CustomField.description: The key the generated sample data set gives this person, so a module sample set (the Giving gifts, for example) can join its own records to the people and households the Core loader created. Empty on every record an administrator entered.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by the sample data loader (C-10) on each person it creates, so sample gifts and pledges attach to the right sample record. Leave it empty on your own records.
